items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: The whole man they had some stuff used to tell. Big like Lula White's old houses.

ctx.x: You can't tell what's going on in them places, you know, with the windows and the clothes up there. The whole man they had some stuff used to tell. Big like Lula White's old houses. I played music with, I used to play sometime with George Jones, you ever heard of him?
